notes.title: Microphone to call for a target
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36141574/1d928b8da89f9523047e97ab9d256155f518393d.png[/img]

You can now call the target with the microphone embedded in the HMD.

In Options, simply select the microphone in the HMD and set the decibel for the sound the target will call.

notes.title: Emergency Patch (Oculus User)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36141574/ce8f4c4d43ceae8b6351ef79798aa25817ea0bbc.png[/img]

First of all, I apologize for the inconvenience.
I've encountered an issue with some Oculus users that can't run and tried to fix them as soon as possible.
Applying the patch through automatic update can solve the execution problem.
